appContext.summary: A military fitness app for soldiers, ROTC cadets, and service members to calculate official fitness test scores (Army AFT/CFT, Navy PRT, Air Force PT, Marine PFT/CFT, Advanced Readiness, ROTC/Academy), track workouts and GPS runs, follow training plans, earn badges, and manage squad standings for unit PT leaders.

theme.style: A dark tactical command-center world: deep navy-black bases lit by electric cobalt, amber plasma, and neon green light. Surfaces feel like brushed gunmetal, night-vision haze, and cold glass with fine sensor grain; light rakes across the frame in hard directional beams like a briefing room display at 0500. Energy is disciplined and elite — high contrast, heavy shadow, no softness or wellness pastel. Upper thirds stay dark and quiet so headlines read like stenciled mission titles.
